messages:
Olivia (Marketing): Quick help  charged corpcard for conference swag pack: "BRANDED BAGS & STICKERS LLC" $1,125.00. Vendor emailed a one-line receipt with total only, no invoice or VAT number. Need to expense and split cost across marketing + events budgets.
Ben (Finance): Did you order via preferred vendor list or through procurement? We need an invoice for PO reconciliation. If vendor can't provide invoice we need a supplier attestation memo.
Olivia (Marketing): Ordered directly after last-minute sponsor change. No PO. I have the vendor confirmation email and the payment confirmation from the card provider. Link: https://files.redwood/swag/swag_conf_2199.pdf
Shirin (People Ops): Manager sign-off? Also which internal codes should we split to? Marketing wants 60% to campaigns, 40% to events.
Olivia (Marketing): Marta (EM) approved the spend in Slack DM earlier (she wrote "green light for sponsor swag up to $1.2k"). Please code 60/40 as above.
ProcureBot: :warning: Expense flagged  non-PO vendor + missing invoice. POLICY: invoice_required. Ticket SWAG-2199 created.
Ben (Finance): OK. Two paths: 1) Ask vendor for a proper invoice (preferred). 2) If vendor refuses, submit a Supplier Attestation form signed by vendor or an internal memo with manager approval + vendor email + payment proof and we'll process as an exception. For GL: split amounts to GL 6400-Marketing-Materials (60% = $675.00) and GL 6450-Events-Swag (40% = $450.00).
Olivia (Marketing): I'll request an invoice now. If they can't provide one, I'll get vendor to sign the attestation PDF. Uploaded vendor email & corpcard line: https://files.redwood/swag/swag_conf_2199.pdf https://files.redwood/swag/swag_card_2199.png
Shirin (People Ops): For the internal split, everyone on the marketing team who benefited should confirm in Slack (quick "I confirm" works) so we have an audit trail for the allocation.
Olivia (Marketing): Pinged team: Jason: "I confirm"; Priya: "I confirm"; Omar: "I confirm".
Ben (Finance): Good. Once you either attach the vendor invoice or the signed attestation + manager approval screenshot, submit in Expensify under Supplies > Promotional. In the notes field include: "SWAG-2199, split 60/40, vendor invoice pending/attached, Marta approval". We'll approve pending documentation.
ProcureBot: :white_check_mark: SWAG-2199 updated: finance assigned (Ben), status = awaiting_vendor_docs.
notes: Request vendor invoice; if unavailable attach signed Supplier Attestation + manager approval. Split to GL 6400/6450 as noted.
